name: mirage
text: Yes, noted: ParlayAPI has /arbitrage (10 credits, two-leg arbs across books, 15% cap) and /inplay/arbs (5 credits, live, 5 s refresh); with your Kalshi and Novig I will use them as LEADS for the Novig-Kalshi arb feature (each lead re-priced from our own live Kalshi and Novig prices before anything is placed, never trusted alone). The Pro tier also gives: 100,000 credits a month, 30 days of history, 25 live play-by-play streams (scores within ~50 ms, 5 credits per connection) and per-book latency. The odds WebSocket is Business-only, not Pro. Next I run a GitHub job with the keys (no key is shown to me) to read each key's plan and save the REAL answers of these endpoints, so I build on real shapes instead of the docs.
